title: Unspeakable
summary: UNSPE'AKABLE, adjective That cannot be uttered; that cannot be expressed; unuterable; as unspeakable grief or rage. 2 Corinthians 12:4. Joy unspeakable and full of glory. 1 Peter 1:8.
